option_relations.rationale: PARP inhibitor-induced interstitial lung disease (ILD) is a specific type of pulmonary toxicity due to chemotherapy, making the option a supertype of the leaf.
Drug-induced interstitial lung disease (pneumonitis) is a broader category that encompasses pulmonary toxicity due to chemotherapy, making the option a supertype of the leaf.
Drug-induced pneumonitis is a broader category that encompasses pulmonary toxicity due to chemotherapy, making the option a supertype of the leaf.
Hypersensitivity pneumonitis is a distinct condition caused by an immune response to inhaled antigens, which is not directly related to chemotherapy-induced pulmonary toxicity.
